verdict.rationale: Clerky is a legal-paperwork SaaS, so in-product AI insights are a fair question for this kind of product, but the evidence pack never mentions any AI-generated insights or suggestions inside Clerky itself. The only AI-related capability is a remote MCP server that lets external assistants such as Claude and ChatGPT read team data. That is an external-assistant integration, not in-product AI, so it is not credited here.
